suācikkhita: [ su + ā + cikkha + ta ] (ti) CL=7 That which should be spoken well.
suāgamana: [ su + ā + gamu + yu ] (na) CL=7 Approaching in a good manner.
suājīvakara: [ su + ā + jīva + kara + a ] (ti) CL=7 A person who leads a good livelihood.
suānaya: [ su + ā + nī + a ] (ti) CL=7 That which should be acquired easily.
